title: Inverse coefficient problem for the wave equation with nonlocal attenuation
summary: In this article, we investigate the inverse problem of determining time-dependent first- and zeroth-order coefficients for a wave equation with nonlocal-in-time attenuation on a Riemannian manifold, using boundary measurements. This problem is motivated by applications in imaging and viscoelasticity, where such equations arise naturally, and we aim to characterize the properties of the underlying medium by recovering these coefficients.
